name: FFS_ROUTE
description: Stores resource routes created for particular days.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the route.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the resource this route belongs to.

columns.name: ROUTE_DATE
columns.description: Route date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: ACTIVATED
columns.description: Resource's route activation time. Time is specified in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format and in the time zone of the resource to which the route is assigned.

columns.name: DEACTIVATED
columns.description: Resource's route deactivation time. Time is specified in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format and in the time zone of the resource to which the route is assigned.

columns.name: TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Resource's route time zone .Reference to resource time zone identifier.

columns.name: DIFF
columns.description: Resource's route time zone diffirence from GMT time. Calculated automatically after time_zone_id selection.

columns.name: FINAL_TRAVEL
columns.description: Travel to final resource location.

columns.name: FINAL_TRAVEL_ESTIMATION_METHOD
columns.description: Method that was used to make current traveling time estimation.

columns.name: FINAL_TRAVEL_FROM_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a previous activity for the final travel. It is only used when a final travel is set with an adjustment.

columns.name: CALENDAR_TIME_FROM
columns.description: Start of working time interval.

columns.name: CALENDAR_TIME_TO
columns.description: Resource's route end of working time interval.

columns.name: CALENDAR_POINTS
columns.description: Resource's route number of available points for distrubution by routing.

columns.name: CALENDAR_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Resource's route schedule .Reference to schedule identifier.

columns.name: CALENDAR_SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Resource's route shift .Reference to shift identifier.

columns.name: CALENDAR_NON_WORKING_REASON_ID
columns.description: Resource's route non-working reason .Reference to non-working reasoins identifier.

columns.name: START_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: ID of start location for this day.

columns.name: FINAL_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: ID of final location for this day.

columns.name: REACTIVATED
columns.description: Resource's route reactivation time. Time is specified in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format and in the time zone of the resource to which the route is assigned.

columns.name: UNPAID_START_TRAVEL
columns.description: Really occupied part of unpaid travel from start provider location - minutes.

columns.name: UNPAID_FINAL_TRAVEL
columns.description: Really occupied part of unpaid travel to final provider location - minutes.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Activities in the past. Version of queue cache where this queue was last modified.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
